sections.heading: tySpacewarpObject
sections.content: ThetySpacewarpobject can be used to converttyFlowforce helpers (ex:tyVortex) into spacewarps that are compatible with 3rd party plugins (ex: PhoenixFD).

sections.heading: Input force
sections.content:
Force object: the inputtyFlowforce helper which will be converted into a regular spacewarp.Strength mult: a multiplier which will be applied to the resulting force calculations.
